name: Vending Gore Arcade: The Loot Lesson
read_aloud: Rows of vending machines hum in a dozen colors, and some of them are breathing. One screen promises that you deserve this. A woman in scrubs lies face-down in the wrappers, one arm still reaching for it. This is the loot lesson, and she is the first page.
narrator_line: Rows of vending machines hum in a dozen colors, and some of them are breathing.
layout: A long hall of vending machines, half smashed and half glowing and faintly breathing, with a body in scrubs face-down in the middle of the floor.

exits.name: On to the Hall of Fair Warnings (Z4).
A false panel behind the change machine opens the back cage (3b; hidden, check values in 00-overview.md section 5.3).

features.name: Machines (half cover; the breathing ones are a bad idea).
Hungry vendors bite a reaching arm (a Dexterity save, then Strength (Athletics) to pull free; section 5.3).
Prying a machine open is loud: one Ceiling Ticks roll (section 5.11).

quick_run.setup: A hall of hungry vending machines, a fallen Crawler's cache, and a crate with a strange stamped coin.
quick_run.decision: Reach into the machines, pry them open loudly, or search the body and the crate first?
quick_run.on_success: They loot the hall, read Tanya's note and pocket the stamped coin.
quick_run.on_failure: Arms get bitten, a loud pry draws a Ceiling Ticks roll, and the cache behind the change machine stays hidden.
quick_run.cut_short: One roll per Crawler on the vending table; hand over Tanya's cache and the coin without checks.

loot.text: Tanya Ruiz's corpse cache: a Mop-Handle Staff, a lore scrap, a Potion of Healing reskinned as Sports Drink, Red Flavor, and some credits (00-overview.md sections 5.3 and 8.3, potion #1).
Lost & Found crate: junk and the Odd Coin (spine plant; log the holder; never explain it). 00-overview.md sections 5.3 and 8.4.
Back cage (3b) hidden cache: a Potion of Healing (potion #2), a riot shield, credits, and the scrawled map that reveals Zone S (00-overview.md section 5.3).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
